use_case_summary: Use-case: Multilingual RAG enterprise search (retrieval via dense embeddings + reranking). Index size ~50M docs. Requirements: per-language recall/precision tuning (Spanish, French, German, Mandarin, Arabic priority), strict EU data residency, SSO/SAML, audit logs, KMS control. Performance targets: retrieval p50 <80ms, rerank end-to-end p95 <350ms; cost target <$0.03/query at scale. Preferred approach: multilingual embedding model (1536-d vectors), vector index sharded by language + language-aware nearest-neighbor reranker (cross-encoder) for top-50 candidates. Must support incremental indexing, multilingual tokenizers, language-specific analyzers and evaluation metrics per language (precision@k, recall@k).
poC_scope: 2-week reranking POC: ingest 5M sample subset (representative by language), run retrieval + rerank configs (embedding model variants + quantization levels), produce per-language evaluation (precision@5, recall@10), measure latency/cost. Deliverables: eval report, cost model, recommended deployment (dedicated vs private).
technical_notes: Indexing: expect 50M docs; plan sharded vector index by language to reduce cross-lingual noise.
Embeddings: evaluate mpnet-multilingual-1536 and XLM-R large variants; test 8-bit quantized embeddings for storage trade-offs.
Reranker: test distilled mT5-cross-encoder (multilingual) versus a light-weight Transformer reranker; latency trade-offs important.
Routing: EU-only routing + automated fallback to dedicated EU region; need capacity reservation for reranker during peak business hours.
Monitoring: per-language precision/recall dashboards, tokenized latency histograms, cost-per-query breakdown (embedding + ANN + reranker).
Quality controls: per-language prompt/eval sets, regression alerts when recall drops >5% for a language.
Data pipelines: require delta indexing, dedup heuristics (language-aware), and metadata preservation (jurisdiction tags).
